description: A litigant who approaches the court must get to know what judgment is given on his plea,” the CJI said. The same HC judge, Justice Rongon Mukhopadhyay, was found to have kept several judgments pending for years, even in cases where the convicts had appealed against their capital and life sentences. The judge had delivered the verdicts in those cases only after SC took judicial notice of the same.
title: Judges reserving verdicts for years ‘an ailment’: Supreme Court

author: PARTHA BEHERA
description: A bench headed by Chief Justice Ramesh Sinha held that the family court’s order showed no illegality or defect warranting interference by the HC. The HC noted that when the husband had filed a petition seeking restitution of conjugal rights, the woman could have returned to her matrimonial home to resume marital life.
title: Woman not entitled to maintenance if living apart sans valid reason: HC

author: TNN
description: A division bench of Justice Rajan Roy and Justice AK Chaudhary passed the verdict on a PIL filed by Motilal Yadav in 2013, seeking direction against holding of caste-based rallies by political parties. In an interim order in July 2013 itself, a bench of Justice Uma Nath Singh and Justice Mahendra Dayal had stayed caste-based rallies “with immediate effect” throughout UP.
title: Wooing voters on caste, religion lines no ground to bar party: HC

author: KHUSHI BHUTA
description: A 36-year-old businessman tragically died after a road rage incident in Delhi's Connaught Place. Shivam Gupta was allegedly beaten with helmets by two food delivery riders following a minor collision. Despite initial recovery signs, Gupta succumbed to his injuries weeks later. Police have arrested two suspects, with a third reportedly involved in handing over the weapon.
title: 36-year-old Delhi businessman dies after being beaten with helmet by food delivery riders
